  • productivity (noun): This is a noun, meaning the efficiency of production or the rate at which work is completed. It fits grammatically and contextually after 'increased worker'.

Related structure or vocabulary: Verb + noun: Some verbs, like 'increase', are followed by a noun as their object. 'Productivity' is a common noun used in business and office contexts to refer to the efficiency of workers.
